answer: Give every agent a single beacon identity recorded in a public work ledger: to join, it locks a refundable deposit in a vault and completes a slow series of small verified jobs, each signed into the ledger. Reputation accrues only from completed work, not from self-declared claims, so a marble-clean record takes weeks to build. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must fund a vault deposit and pay the time cost for each one, while a single detected fraud slashes the deposit and burns the whole history, making sybil farming far more expensive than the work it could steal.
